description: Directed-graph diagnostic schema for the subscription cancellation wedge. Accepts any US state. Per PRD §7.1. v1.1: Added account_identifier, billing_email, cancellation_effective_date, refund_request nodes for richer email generation.

jurisdiction.question: In which state do you live?

refusal_check_litigation.question: Is there currently a lawsuit or legal dispute pending between you and this company?

refusal_check_government.question: Is this a government-run service or a service mandated by your municipality (like a utility)?

service_vertical.question: What type of service or subscription is this?

refusal_check_financed.question: Is this subscription tied to a financed device, equipment loan, or installment payment plan?

refusal_check_bundled.question: Is this subscription part of a bundled contract with other services (e.g., phone + internet + TV)?

bundled_warning.message: Bundled contracts may have different cancellation terms for each component. We can help you draft a cancellation request, but the bundle terms may affect what can be cancelled separately. We'll include a note about this in your cancellation emails.

company_name.question: What is the name of the company or service?

account_identifier.question: What is your account number, customer ID, or username with this company?
account_identifier.help_text: This helps the company locate your account quickly. Check your billing email or account settings page. If you only have a billing email, enter that.
account_identifier.placeholder: e.g., CUS-12345, john.doe, or your billing email

fields.label: How much are you being charged?
What email address is on this account?
fields.help_text: The email associated with your subscription account — this may be different from your Resolvaio login email.

fields.label: When did the subscription start (approximate is fine)?
Date of the most recent charge

cancellation_attempts.question: Have you already tried to cancel this subscription?

cancellation_attempt_details.question: Tell us about your cancellation attempt:

fields.label: When did you try to cancel?
What happened?
options: They said it was cancelled but I was still charged
I couldn't find how to cancel
I was put on hold/transferred and gave up
They said there's a cancellation fee
They said I'm in a contract period

fields.label: Did you get a confirmation number?

options.label: I can't find how to cancel
They require a phone call to cancel
There's an early termination or cancellation fee
They say I'm locked into a contract
It auto-renewed without my clear consent

cancellation_effective_date.question: When should the cancellation take effect?

refund_request.question: Are you requesting a refund for charges made after you tried to cancel, or for unauthorized charges?
refund_request.help_text: If you were charged after requesting cancellation, or if you were auto-renewed without clear consent, you may want to request a refund for those charges.

refund_details.question: Tell us about the refund you are requesting:

fields.label: How much are you requesting back?
fields.help_text: The total amount you believe you were charged incorrectly or after your cancellation attempt.

contract_terms.question: About the contract terms (answer what you can):

fields.label: Do you have a written contract or terms of service?
Is there a minimum commitment period?
Were you clearly told about auto-renewal before you signed up?

evidence_upload.question: Upload any documents that may help (all optional):
evidence_upload.help_text: Common uploads: recent billing statement, contract/terms, cancellation confirmation or denial, any correspondence with the company.

generation.notes: Subscription cancellation is free at launch — no paywall step

checkpoints.question: Have you sent Email 1? Time for Email 2.
Have you sent Email 2? Time for Email 3.
